name: nightly-check__sales-process
text:
---
description: >-
  The full five-lane support-ticket lifecycle (Customer, Sales, Technical
  support, Tester, Development) with two distinct finish points (Finished1,
  Finished2) and per-lane color coding via wildcard `classDef`/`class`
  assignments (teal/indigo/violet/orange/yellow), exercising class-based
  styling combined with a large multi-lane, multi-loop swimlane graph.
config:
  logLevel: 0
  htmlLabels: false
  flowchart:
    useMaxWidth: false
---
swimlane-beta LR
  subgraph C["Customer"]
  C1(["Customer requests help or reports errors"])
  C2["More feedback"]
  Finished1
  Finished2
  end

  subgraph S["Sales"]
  S1{"Sales issue"}
  S2["Resolve the issue and respond to customer"]
  T3["Confirm with customer"]
  T5["Confirm with customer"]
  end

  subgraph T["Technical support"]
  T1{"New issue"}
  T2["Resolve solution"]
  T4["Get more details from customer"]
  T6["Resolve solution"]
  end

  subgraph Tester["Tester"]
  Te1["Test the issue"]
  Te2{"Reproduced the issue"}
  D4{"Resolved?"}
  end

  subgraph D["Development"]
  D1["Error report"]
  D2["Technical analysis"]
  D3["Fix the issue"]

  end

  %% Edges
  C1 --> S1
  S1 -- Yes --> S2 --> T3 --> Finished1(["Finished"])
  S1 -- No --> T1
  T1 -- No --> T2 --> T3
  T1 -- Yes --> Te1 --> Te2
  Te2 -- Yes --> D1 --> D2 --> D3 --> D4
  Te2 -- No --> T4
  T4 -- No --> C2
  D4 -- No --> D2
  D4 -- Yes --> T6 --> T5
  T5 --> Finished2(["Finished"])

  %% Classes for coloring
  classDef indigo stroke:#818cf8,fill:#eef2ff;
  classDef teal stroke:#2dd4bf,fill:#f0fdfa;
  classDef violet stroke:#a78bfa,fill:#f5f3ff;
  classDef orange stroke:#fb923c,fill:#fff7ed;
  classDef yellow stroke:#facc15,fill:#fefce8;

  class C* teal;
  class S* indigo;
  class T* violet;
  class Tester* orange;
  class D* yellow;
